description: This PHP class defines the 'EmpDirectDebit' entity, mapping to the 'hs_hr_emp_directdebit' database table. It models direct debit details associated with an employee's salary, including routing number, account info, amount, account type, and transaction type, with ORM annotations to facilitate database operations.

classes.name: EmpDirectDebit
classes.description: Entity class representing employee direct debit details for payroll processing.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the direct debit record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the direct debit record.

methods.name: getRoutingNumber
methods.description: Returns the bank routing number for the direct debit.

methods.name: setRoutingNumber
methods.description: Sets the bank routing number for the direct debit.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Returns the bank account details for the direct debit.

methods.name: setAccount
methods.description: Sets the bank account details for the direct debit.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount to be debited.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount to be debited.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the type of bank account (savings, checking, other).

methods.name: setAccountType
methods.description: Sets the type of bank account.
